guide_wording: A hypothetical individual meets the ten-of-fifteen residence test, has never used art. 93, and loses IRPF residence after **2026**. The combined-value test is met; the positive gain is **2 million**, not the 5-million market value. At 2026 savings rates its incremental tax is `71,880 + (2,000,000 −300,000) ×30% =581,880`.
